name: Kimpton Charlotte Square
positioning: Hotel in seven interconnected Georgian townhouses beside a private garden in Edinburgh's New Town (official name Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel)
best_for: Travelers who want a Georgian townhouse hotel in Edinburgh's New Town
Guests traveling with a dog or cat

facts.text: The hotel sits beside a private garden in Edinburgh's New Town.
The hotel is made up of seven interconnected Georgian townhouses.
The hotel has a classical Georgian exterior.
Inside the hotel is a glass-topped central courtyard.
The hotel has a spa and a fitness center.
The hotel has one indoor pool.
Spa treatments use natural, organic ingredients and products by Scottish skincare lines.
The hotel's destination restaurant is BABA.
Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2024 ranked the hotel number 16 in the Top Hotels in the UK.

highlights.text: No. 33 is a hotel within a hotel with its own private entrance.
Invisible Cities, a social enterprise offering immersive walking tours, is linked to the hotel.
Pets are welcome at the hotel, and it does not charge extra for them.
No. 33 includes two event spaces, The Dining Room and The Drawing Room.

considerations.text: Valet parking is in a secure underground car park beneath the hotel, subject to availability, and must be reserved in advance directly with the hotel.
The hotel does not offer complimentary breakfast.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the historic city center location.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel
